description: Normalized public observability contract for GARHY Engineering OS. Current public inputs are deployment snapshots and synthetic reachability probes; richer OpenTelemetry metrics, logs and traces can be ingested later without changing the UI contract.

logs.reason: Runtime logs can contain sensitive operational context and remain private.

traces.reason: Distributed traces remain in the private operator plane.

futureIngestion.boundary: Only aggregated, explicitly public-safe telemetry may be materialized into GitHub Pages data files.
